# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloudflare Containers — run execution services natively on Cloudflare.
#
# CF Containers (beta) let Workers communicate with Docker containers via a
# Durable Object proxy. Each [[containers]] entry must have a matching
# [[durable_objects.bindings]] entry with the same class_name (see above).
# The DO starts the container, monitors its lifecycle, and proxies HTTP via
# this.ctx.container.getTcpPort(8080).
#
# Local dev fallback (enable_containers = false in [dev]):
#   Container DOs fall back to: SIDECAR_URL env var (.dev.vars) →
#   KV SANDBOX_BRIDGE_URL → localhost:8788.
#
# Required secrets (set via `wrangler secret put`):
#   - none for CF Container paths (DO ↔ container auth is implicit)
#   - SIDECAR_URL + SIDECAR_API_KEY for non-CF / local-dev direct-URL fallback
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloudflare Containers — run execution services natively on Cloudflare.
#
# CF Containers (beta) let Workers communicate with Docker containers via
# a Fetcher service binding. No external servers needed.
#
# Required secrets (set via `wrangler secret put`):
#   - none for containers (authentication is implicit via the binding)
#
# For external sidecar fallback (optional, for non-CF deployments):
#   wrangler secret put SIDECAR_URL
#   wrangler secret put SIDECAR_API_KEY
